name: Online Learning Checklist
description: An online learning checklist that helps students succeed in online and virtual classes.

items.text: Confirm your computer and internet connection are reliable.
Test your webcam, microphone and speakers.
Install the required learning platform and apps.
Bookmark the course site, syllabus and login pages.
Have a backup plan if your connection drops.
items.note: Know a nearby Wi-Fi spot or keep mobile data ready.

items.text: Add all live sessions and class times to your calendar.
Note when recorded lectures and materials are released.
Block regular study time for each course.
Set reminders for assignments and exams.
Plan around any time-zone differences.
Choose a quiet, dedicated spot for studying.
Keep your materials and charger within reach.
Silence phone notifications during class and study.
Close unrelated tabs and apps while you work.
Use focused work blocks with short breaks.
Join live sessions on time and stay engaged.
Take notes just as you would in person.
Ask questions in chat or by unmuting.
Post in discussion boards and reply to classmates.
Attend office hours when you need help.
Check the course site regularly for updates.
Submit assignments before each deadline.
Confirm each upload went through successfully.
Review feedback and grades as they post.
Back up your work in the cloud or on a drive.

faq.q: How do I succeed in online classes?
faq.a: Set up reliable tech, build a consistent weekly schedule, claim a distraction-free study space, participate actively in discussions and live sessions, and track every deadline so nothing slips by unnoticed.

faq.q: How do I stay focused during online learning?
faq.a: Study in a dedicated space, close unrelated tabs and silence notifications, work in focused blocks with short breaks, and treat live sessions like in-person class by taking notes and engaging.

faq.q: What tech do I need for an online class?
faq.a: A reliable computer and internet connection, a working webcam and microphone, the required apps or learning platform installed, and a backup plan such as mobile data in case your connection drops.

faq.q: How is this different from a distance learning checklist?
faq.a: This online learning checklist targets college and self-paced virtual courses. A distance learning checklist focuses on at-home K-12 remote schooling and the parent support that goes with it.

faq.q: Can I download this online learning checklist as a PDF?
faq.a: Yes. You can print it or download it as a PDF and keep it by your workspace as a setup and weekly routine.
